context_sensitive_titles_warning: 王 / 大王 / 寡人: Resolve by speaker and passage context (e.g., King Xi of Yan, King Zheng of Qin / Qin Shi Huang, King Jian of Qi, King Jia of Wei, or King Fuchu of Chu).
太子: Usually Crown_Prince_Dan in Yan/assassination contexts, but check non-Yan passages (e.g., Zhao crown prince in Shiji 43).
趙王: Resolve across reigns (King Xiaocheng, King Daoxiang, King Qian/Youmiu) rather than collapsing into one person node.
荊王 / 楚王: Distinguish King You, King Ai (Hao), King Fuchu, and Lord Changping by year and event.
相 / 丞相 / 將 / 將軍 / 太傅: Title/rank shorthand; map to the specific person node via surrounding names/context rather than guessing.
使者 / 燕使者 / 賓客 / 左右: Often unnamed envoys, retainers, or attendants; do not force onto a named person node unless identified.
三晉 / 諸侯 / 六國 / 天下 / 百越: Collective or macro-regional terms; decide explicitly whether to map to specific state nodes or exclude from person-level edges.
太后 / 先王 / 母家: Kinship or predecessor references; keep separate from active characters unless explicitly modeled.
Rhetorical allusions and historiographical citations to exclude from active action edges: 殷紂, 商容, 箕子, 箕左, 柳下惠, 管, 晏, 曹沫, 齊桓公, 白公勝, 要離, 聶政, 揚子, 鄒衍, 莊襄王, 周文, 武.
我 (Shiji 43 趙世家): hereditary-house first person = Zhao state, not a person.
昌壯/昌城: Zhao city attacked by Yan in Shiji 43 S009; do not confuse with Dai.

王@S005 (ZGC 秦并趙).evidence: 秦并趙 context (228 BCE); King Xiaocheng died earlier (S013 孝成王卒). 趙王系之 = King Qian detained the Yan envoy.

趙王@S050/S062 (Shiji 06 / ZZTJ 228 BCE).evidence: 得趙王 / 虜趙王遷 immediately after the fall of Handan; 趙王遷 named explicitly in S062.

王@S070/S073/S076/S078 (ZZTJ Qin narrativ.evidence: Speaker is the King of Qin in 始皇帝 20-22 nian entries; 始皇/王 used interchangeably in ZZTJ.

王@S093/S094 (ZZTJ Qi narratives).evidence: 齊王將入朝 / 即墨大夫見齊王; the only reigning Qi king in 221 BCE context.

荊王@S053 (Shiji 06).evidence: 虜荊王 occurs before 項燕立昌平君為荊王 in the same segment; per warning, 荊王 distinguished by event order.

荊王@S059 (Shiji 73).evidence: 歲餘，虜荊王負芻 - explicit name 負芻.

太子@S051/S057 (Shiji 06/73).evidence: 燕太子丹患秦兵 / 逐燕太子丹 - Yan context, not the Zhao crown prince.

我@S012 (Shiji 43 趙世家 hereditary voice).evidence: 秦拔我晉陽 - the annalistic 我 = the house of Zhao (Zhao Shijia).

昌壯@S009 (Shiji 43).evidence: 燕攻昌壯 = Yan attacking Chang (昌城), a Zhao city; hence Yan->Zhao military edge, not Yan->Dai.

蒙〔武〕(恬)@S073/S077 (ZZTJ collation bracke.evidence: ZZTJ collation: base text 武, emendation 恬; Shiji 73 parallel (S057) has 蒙恬. Both generals' edges recorded where the campaign involves both.

單于/單於@S019/S036/S067.evidence: Chanyu = ruler of the Xiongnu; alliance proposal target.

三晉@S018/S035/S067.evidence: 威脅韓、魏、趙氏 names all three; 約三晉 = alliance with the three states. Recorded as separate edges per state.

寡人/君@S002 (ZGC 燕王謝樂間書).evidence: 燕王以書且謝焉 names the sender; addressee 君 is Yue Jian, who had defected to Zhao (S001 樂間入趙). Historically 燕王喜遺樂間書.

implicit object@S004 (ZGC).evidence: 樂間、樂乘怨不用其計 - resentment targets the ruler who rejected their counsel; no 燕王 surface form in this short segment.

implicit subject 荊軻@S027 (ZGC).evidence: 既至秦，持千金之資幣物，厚遺…蒙嘉 - subject carried over from S026 (荊軻遂就車而去); no 荊軻 surface form in S027.

implicit issuer@S029 (ZGC 詔王翦軍以伐燕).evidence: 詔 (decree) implies the Qin king as issuer; 秦 appears as state actor in the same segment.

implicit subject 秦@S062 (ZZTJ annal).evidence: 克邯鄲，虜趙王遷 - ZZTJ annalistic style omits the Qin subject; context is the Qin conquest of Zhao.

子假@S066 (ZZTJ).evidence: 魏景湣王薨，子假立 - 子假 (= son Jia) is the succession formula for 魏王假.
